text: Implemented Edf2AscProvenance.scala with private, Either-based constructors for converter identity, exact scientific arguments, observed and user-declared successful receipts, normal/failsafe mode, release/exploratory evidence policy, explicit warnings, and domain-separated canonical SHA-256 identity. Added Sha256.fromHex with operand-specific sealed failures. Release assessment requires both an identified receipt and EDF digest; exploratory use retains every weakening as warnings; nonzero observed exit codes cannot produce a receipt; user-declared conversions never claim process observation. Edf2AscProvenanceSuite covers malformed digests, blank/hostile arguments, failed exit status, strict and exploratory policies, failsafe warnings, canonical identity sensitivity, and private construction. Focused post-format JVM and Scala.js runs passed 14/14 combined contract+provenance tests on each platform; scalafmtCheckAll passed.
